reviews.evidence: End-to-end SOP covers reference search, design-system extraction, replica seeding, branching, flows, presentations, and HTML export.
reviews.concern: Only an external video thumbnail; no actual generated design output or recovery workflow is shown.

reviews.evidence: MCP, CLI, Python, and DSH search/intake flows; three problem→fix→verify lessons, a GIF, compatibility, proxy, CI, and security guidance.
reviews.concern: It retrieves failure lessons rather than executing or validating fixes in the user's environment.

reviews.evidence: Timeline, folders, prompts, export, formula/code tools, backup, and settings span 13 named AI platforms; long-chat pain points are explicit.
reviews.concern: Operations and demonstrations are thin; most behavior is described rather than walked through.

reviews.evidence: Complete prompt→video→alpha asset→dual-format plugin workflow, rich configuration, balance events, six runtime shots, and many animation GIFs.
reviews.concern: Only one substantial worked use case; security and general troubleshooting coverage are limited.

reviews.evidence: Composable research system spans literature, gaps, hypotheses, stress tests, experiments, specs, checkpoints, and a worked spec session.
reviews.concern: Demo is largely narrated; few actual research artifacts or failure remedies are shown.

reviews.evidence: Three concrete story worlds cover observation, goal-driven play, and generated worlds, with runnable commands, UI actions, configs, and previews.
reviews.concern: README gives requirements and port limits but little test, security, or troubleshooting evidence.

reviews.evidence: Glass theme ships Mica/compatibility modes, backdrop controls, brightness, particles, edge fades, exact settings paths, and four screenshots.
reviews.concern: No explicit use case; the README warns current DSH APIs may cause installation crashes.

reviews.evidence: Local Markdown notes become shared agent memory; four explicit work contexts, a basic note-to-agent flow, MCP access, GIF, and many UI states.
reviews.concern: Advanced operations, concrete agent-result examples, validation, and recovery guidance are sparse.

reviews.evidence: Task-band routing, mode tools, hot reload, measured band results, unit/integration tests, and detailed cache, session, subagent, and event caveats.

reviews.evidence: Comprehensive native, managed, JS, browser, Electron, evidence, capture, and comparison workflows with a worked Notes feature investigation.
